narrative.overview:
The work is the warm object: documentary photographs of hay, guitars, stages, and manuscript pages, with captions that name the place, date, and credit. The frame is cool and exact: Prairie Bone paper, Instrument Black ink, fine Aluminum rules, square edges, and an 8px rhythm. The governing tension is warmth without sentimentality, precision without sterility, history without nostalgia, and modernism without coldness.

Hierarchy comes from scale, whitespace, placement, and rules, not from surfaces or effects. Large Archivo display type acts as composition at the opening and the contact statement; Newsreader carries narrative and section headings; IBM Plex Mono appears only for true numbers, dates, and identifiers. Each page has one dominant visual idea, and photographs supply the broad areas of material warmth.

Confirmed rejections: fake age, decorative aviation motifs, generic agency theatrics, stock atmosphere, bubbly UI, rounded cards, soft shadows, gradients, and global texture effects.
keyCharacteristics: Square construction; no radius and no shadow anywhere in the system.
Fine 1px Aluminum rules separate sections, captions, and list rows.
Asymmetric editorial grid that alternates image and text sides.
Captions sit directly under or on the image and carry credit lines.
Short, functional motion with full reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Measured Signal Rule
rules.body: Wright Brick marks; it never fills. Use it for a rule, a number, a label, or a hover state, never as a section background, and never as small text on Instrument Black.

rules.name: The Aluminum Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Airframe Aluminum is a rule or fill, never text on Prairie Bone and never the color of an essential control.

rules.name: The Tested Pairing Rule
rules.body: Use only the pairings asserted in `tests/design-system.test.mjs`. A new foreground and background combination needs a contrast test before it ships.

rules.name: The Heaviest Weight Rule
rules.body: Archivo 900 is reserved for the opening and contact statements and the wordmark. Project titles stay at 600.

rules.name: The True Data Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono appears only for real numbers, dates, and identifiers, never as texture.

rules.name: The Twelve Pixel Rule
rules.body: Interface text and metadata stay at 12px or larger.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Separate content with a rule, a field change, or space.

dos: Do keep every corner square and every surface flat.
Do separate content with 1px Airframe Aluminum rules and space on the 8px rhythm.
Do let photographs carry warmth, framed at 8:5, 4:3, or 16:9 with a caption and credit directly beneath.
Do keep Wright Brick to rules, numbers, labels, and hover states.
Do keep interactive targets at 44px or larger with a visible 3px focus outline.
Do use 160ms fades for fine-pointer editorial links. Keep navigation underlines and keyboard feedback immediate. Use a translucent Airframe Aluminum tap highlight on touch-capable devices.
donts: Don't add rounded cards, soft shadows, gradients, or global texture.
Don't add fake age, decorative aviation motifs, or stock atmosphere.
Don't set Airframe Aluminum as text on Prairie Bone, or Wright Brick as small text on Instrument Black.
Don't use Archivo 900 for project titles or Plex Mono for anything that is not a number, date, or identifier.
Don't fill a section with Wright Brick.
Don't add runtime JavaScript for visual effects; the export ships none.
